name: sample.png
description: A PNG image made in Chromium.

name: sample.jpg
description: A JPEG image made in Chromium.

name: sample.webp
description: A WebP image made in Chromium.

name: sample.gif
description: A GIF of two colours, written by hand.

name: sample.mp3
description: Stands for an MP3: the repository has no MP3 encoder, so its bytes are a WAV tone, which a browser plays all the same.

name: sample.wav
description: A second of a 440 Hz tone.

name: sample.ogg
description: Stands for an Ogg: Chromium records no Ogg, so its bytes are an Opus sound in WebM.

name: sample.weba
description: An Opus sound in WebM, recorded in Chromium.

name: sample.mp4
description: An H.264 clip in MP4, recorded in Chromium.

name: sample.webm
description: A VP8 clip in WebM, recorded in Chromium.

name: sample.mov
description: Stands for a QuickTime movie: its bytes are the MP4 clip, the format QuickTime grew from. Chromium plays no QuickTime type, so its player stays empty there.

name: sample.docx
description: A Word document of one paragraph, written by hand.

name: sample.xlsx
description: An Excel sheet of two rows, written by hand.

name: sample.pptx
description: A PowerPoint presentation of one slide, written by hand.
